What's new in Vekrun 0.5.2 — Bring your work in

• Bring unfinished work into Vekrun: started something in Claude Code, Codex or by hand? Home shows "Unfinished work on <branch>" when your project has uncommitted changes. Vekrun captures your changes as they are now (without touching your folder, index or branch), and a Factory Work Item finishes them in an isolated VM and proves the result. Secret-looking files stay out unless you tick them; anything it can't capture faithfully is listed with the reason; and the Work Item shows the imported work as unverified until Vekrun's own checks pass.
• Search anything opens instantly: listing a big project's files took seconds with the app frozen; it now takes a fraction of a second, off the window's thread, along with the other things the search loads.
• Report a problem: Settings → Updates → Export debug info saves one file with what's needed to look into an issue — versions, agents, tools, settings and your recent Work Items' records — with passwords, keys and tokens removed. Nothing is sent: you choose who gets it.
• A run says when it's running your tests before the agent starts (which can take up to 15 minutes on a big suite), instead of looking stuck on "Installing what your project needs".
• Tickets from Markdown open in a proper dialog with a sample ticket and what each part becomes, and Home tells you about it when your project has no plan yet ("Plan in Markdown? … See how").
